title: Mass of a varifold tangent on balls about 0: μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n (corrected 5.2, step A3)
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N, θ0 ∈ ℝ with Θ^n(μ_V, x) = θ0 (HasDensity n μ_V x (ofReal θ0)), and let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N with IsVarifoldTangent V x C. Then μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0·ω_n·ρ^n for every ρ > 0 (closed ball centred at 0; in ℝ≥0∞: ofReal θ0 * unitBallVolume n * ofReal ρ ^ n). This is Simon 5.2 with the printed centre x corrected to 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (θ₀ : ℝ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ₀) → IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.weight (closedBall 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n
